notes:
## 1.0.3 — 2026-07-27

### Assistant Editor
- **No more 1-frame black gaps between b-roll clips on track 2** — Resolve
  places clips a frame short of plan; overlay b-roll now self-corrects the
  same way the main track always has.
- **Reopen saved plans**: a new "Plans" menu lists every plan (they save to
  the project's Documents/edit_plans automatically, including your toggles
  and swaps) and reopens one with its brief and settings restored — come
  back later, adjust, rebuild.
- **Readable beats**: take transcripts render larger and brighter with much
  more text; hover shows the full transcript and why the take was picked.
- **"Cover this" gap fill** and timeline-aware revisions; per-cut reason
  markers on stringouts.
- **No-limit target** — a 0:00 target includes every clip that fits the
  brief; the target field is now m:ss.
- **Honest model routing**: picking Opus/Sonnet in the planner really uses
  it, even when the app-wide provider is Ollama/OpenAI (it previously could
  silently run on the local model and return hollow plans).
- The planner now gets a **day summary** — the shape of the shoot day — for
  smarter story structure.

### Clip analysis (Rich descriptions)
- **Time-windowed describes with finer timestamped events**, fused into a
  single clip summary; long clips no longer blur into one vague paragraph.
- **Gyro ground truth**: fused gyro events carry direction and measured
  speed into descriptions; peak moments get flagged.
- **Mid-run recalibration** — when the GPU frees up, description quality
  steps back up automatically; VLM caps are adjustable in Settings.
- Search-index jobs drain before describes so calibration gets a clean card.

### Settings & privacy
- **Settings overhaul**: per-stage panels on AI Features (Motion, Search
  index, Stability), a new Accounts & Services page, and stage lists shown
  in pipeline order.
- **Video descriptions stay local unless you explicitly opt into cloud**,
  with the engine switch moved out of Connections.

### Reliability
- Hardened core file handling: atomic writes, consistent backups, safe
  overwrite/relocate, and database gates.
